website.notes: Copenhagen-founded social impact company (2015) fighting food waste through a surplus-food marketplace. The Parcels business is a direct-to-consumer channel for ambient, shelf-stable surplus stock from FMCG manufacturers and wholesalers.

reviews.notes: No review-site page verified in this pass.

linkedin.notes: Not verified in this pass. Posting states 1,300+ colleagues across 19 countries and 180+ in Tech & Product.

media.notes: Circular Online (4 Feb 2026): 300,000 Parcels distributed since the 2024 launch; partners with CEVA Logistics; brands include Tony's Chocolonely, Heinz, McVities, Amoy, Jamie Oliver and Alpro; parcels are ambient/tinned surplus stock delivered to the customer's chosen location. Also: https://www.foodanddrinktechnology.com/news/55731/too-good-to-go-launches-parcels-programme-to-revolutionise-the-management-of-surplus-food/ (6 Nov 2024): Parcels launched in the UK and across Denmark, the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Italy, Germany and Austria; brands ship stock to a Midlands packing facility managed by CEVA Logistics.
